title: EFWI: Multiparameter Benchmark Datasets for Elastic Full Waveform Inversion of Geophysical Properties
findings: The paper does not analyze any aspect of religion or faith. Its focus is on geophysics and creating a benchmark dataset (EFWI) for elastic full waveform inversion to model subsurface geological properties.
